sobre.lead: The FIPV, International Pikivoley Federation, is born to regulate, organize and spread Pikivoley around the world.
sobre.corpo: The FIPV is responsible for making the international rules official, standardizing courts, nets, balls, equipment, categories and competition formats, and recognizing the national bodies that govern Pikivoley in each country.
sobre.lema: From South America to the world. Any ground, game on.
